text:
Emma: Quick sync  we need to finalize rollout for the tenant opt-in flag by EOW. Customer wants per-tenant opt-in, EU regulatory holdback, canary windows, A/B checks, and a kill-switch. Who can own capacity/RTO?

Raj: Ill own capacity. Proposal: tenant-slice rollout: 1% tenants -> 5% -> 20% over 48h if metrics stable. Need to ensure Dedicated pools don't starve baseline traffic.

Chris: Runtime notes  1% by tenant is fine, but prefer combining region+tenant slices to shrink blast radius. Recommend pre-warming KV-prefix cache for canary tenants.

Taylor: For quality gating, suggest shadowing plus a 5% A/B test on opted-in hosts. Keep token budget <5M/day for the test. Auto-rollback if semantic-regression >2% on our eval set.

Emma: Proposed launch criteria: (a) 24h with zero P0s, (b) p99 latency <400ms for canaries, (c) quality regression <2% on evals, (d) legal signoff for EU routing. OK?

Raj: Agree. Need a reliable kill-switch. We must be able to immediately divert affected tenant traffic to stable variant or a fallback quantized model.

Chris: We have /flags/kill in control plane. Plan: layering for flags: tenant-override -> region-policy -> global-default. Kill flips tenant-override to fallback. Add per-tenant soft-redirect to smaller model & log sampling.

Taylor: Rollback runbook draft: 1) flip kill-switch, 2) set rollout pct to 0, 3) smoke tests for affected tenants, 4) notify customers + SRE ops. I'll publish runbook to #eng-oncall by EOD.

Emma: Customer wants premium customers exempt from early canary (they require SLA). Can we make premium opt-out so they continue on stable variant?

Raj: Yes. Add tier gating: premium customers skip canary. We'll need reserved capacity for that.

Chris: Capacity implication: reserve ~10% Dedicated capacity as warm standby for the new variant during rollout. Otherwise premium p99 could spike.

Taylor: Telemetry/UX: surface per-tenant latency + cost delta and a per-tenant quality-score delta in Redwood Console for the flag. Also surface quota burn alerts.

Emma: For EU legal: pin EU tenants to Private VPC routing during canary to reduce residency risk. Legal to confirm; flag config should support region-force routing.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for feature flag "tenant-optin-v2" at 2025-07-15T09:12Z. Canary slices: eu-west-1 sampled tenants, us-west-2 tenants (1%). :rocket:

Chris: Add a schema/contract smoke in canary pipeline to ensure function/tool calling compatibility with fallback variant. We have contract-checkers, but run a quick schema test too.

Emma: Action items: (1) Taylor publish runbook link in #eng-oncall, (2) Raj update capacity plan + reserve 10% Dedicated, (3) Chris add schema smoke step, (4) Legal ping for EU VPC pin. I'll confirm phased percentages with customer.

Taylor: I'll post runbook link when ready. Also suggest a 48h prompt-paraphrase A/B to validate quality before full ramp.

Raj: Billing constraint from customer: enforce per-tenant cost caps during early rollout. We'll add per-tenant token caps and alert at 80% usage.

Emma: Sounds good. If no objections I'll lock the plan and schedule the canary for tomorrow 08:00. :white_check_mark:

Chris: +1

Taylor: +1

Raj: +1

sre-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for 2025-07-16T08:00Z (awaiting runbook + capacity reservation).
